metadata.provenance: Curated fictional policy copy for the synthetic demo; not a real business offer

articles.title: Boiler service
articles.body: A residential boiler service is a 90-minute maintenance visit with a starting labor price of $189. An on-site technician confirms any additional parts or work before proceeding. Appointments require a service address in an eligible zone and a currently available qualified technician.

articles.title: Heating repair
articles.body: A heating repair visit is scheduled for 120 minutes and starts at $229 for diagnosis and routine labor. Parts and additional work are quoted after inspection. This is not an emergency dispatch service.

articles.title: Plumbing repair
articles.body: Accessible residential pipe, tap, and fixture repairs are scheduled for 90 minutes and start at $159. Hidden leaks or larger repairs may need a new quote or specialist follow-up.

articles.title: Drain clearing
articles.body: Routine sink or tub drain clearing is scheduled for 60 minutes and starts at $139. Main sewer line work is outside this service and should be sent to the operator for review.

articles.title: Electrical diagnostic
articles.body: A residential electrical diagnostic is scheduled for 90 minutes and starts at $179. Major rewiring and urgent electrical hazards are outside online booking; the operator can review those requests.

articles.title: Appliance repair
articles.body: Washer, dryer, and dishwasher diagnosis is scheduled for 120 minutes and starts at $169. The appliance repair service is available in Central and North Maple County only.

articles.title: Roof inspection
articles.body: A visual inspection of an accessible residential roof is scheduled for 120 minutes and starts at $249. Roof inspection is offered in Central and South Maple County only. Unsafe access or storm damage may require operator review.

articles.title: General maintenance
articles.body: Small household repairs suitable for one visit are scheduled for 60 minutes and start at $119. The operator reviews work that needs several trades or unusually large materials.

articles.title: Service zones and travel fees
articles.body: Cedar serves Central, North, and South Maple County in this synthetic demo. Central has no travel fee; North adds $15 and South adds $20. The exact service address and qualified staff availability determine whether an appointment can be offered.

articles.title: Booking, changes, and cancellation
articles.body: A customer must confirm the exact service, date, time, timezone, and service zone before a booking is created. A change or cancellation needs a booking reference plus a local identity verification step. A proposed time is not a reservation; the calendar is checked again at confirmation.

articles.title: Emergencies and unsupported work
articles.body: The browser receptionist cannot promise emergency dispatch or book unsafe work. Requests involving gas leaks, fire, immediate danger, or unsupported services go to a human handoff queue. For immediate danger, customers should contact local emergency services.
